Definition: from G737 and G1084; just born, i.e. (figuratively) a young convert:--new born.
BiblicalUsage: Newborn babes is Peter's picture for new believers: as newborn babes, desire the sincere milk of the word, that ye may grow thereby. The word is used once, and the picture is of a baby's hunger for milk.
TheologicalSignificance: One word for newborn carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is the picture, that the new life in Christ begins hungry, and the milk of the word is what it grows on.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
